en: Typhoon Haiyan, known locally as Yolanda, was one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded to make landfall.
The Philippine province of Romblon is famous for producing high-quality marble, a metamorphic rock formed from limestone.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River features a navigable underground waterway that flows directly through a cave into the sea.
Olympus Mons on Mars is the tallest known volcano in our solar system, standing about three times higher than Mount Everest.
Sirius, also called the Dog Star, is the brightest star visible in the night sky from Earth.
The Apollo 11 astronauts landed their spacecraft in the Mare Tranquillitatis, a large, dark, flat plain on the Moon.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo injected massive amounts of ash and sulfur gases into the atmosphere, temporarily cooling global climates.
The fertile volcanic soil surrounding Mount Mayon in Albay is highly suitable for growing abaca and coconut trees.
Baguio City experiences a subtropical highland climate, making it significantly cooler than the lowland areas of the Philippines.
Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt and the only dwarf planet located entirely within the inner solar system.
The island of Mindoro contains deposits of chromite, a dark, heavy mineral that is the primary ore of chromium.
The Tycho crater on the Moon is a prominent lunar feature with distinct bright rays extending outward from its center.
